name: Cyber Security Incident Playbook — Attack Chain
description: Full attack chain: Initial Access → Privilege Escalation → Persistence → Exfiltration. Demonstrated in a lab environment using Windows 11 VM + Kali Linux.

techniques.comment: Incident #001 — Malicious LNK shortcut delivered via phishing email. Triggers PowerShell download-and-execute chain. Detected by Wazuh rule 100001.
Incident #002 — Insecure scheduled task permissions on cleanup.ps1 (C:\TaskScripts\). Authenticated Users had FullControl. Payload overwrote script to call back on port 4444. Executed as SYSTEM.

Incident #003 — Permanent WMI event subscription using __EventFilter + CommandLineEventConsumer + __FilterToConsumerBinding. Fires every 60 seconds. Survives reboots. Detected via Sysmon Event IDs 19/20/21 and Wazuh.
Incident #004 — finance-data.txt exfiltrated via curl.exe to Python uploadserver (port 8000) over HTTP POST. Executed through existing reverse shell. Detected by Wazuh rule 300004.
Supporting — User clicked malicious LNK shortcut (Incident #001)
Supporting — PowerShell used across multiple incidents for payload download, reverse shell, and WMI persistence
Supporting — Payload (8443.exe) downloaded from attacker HTTP server (Incident #001)
Supporting — 8443.exe deleted after execution to reduce disk artefacts (Incident #001)
